title: Separating model fitting from evaluation
description: You can follow synthetic data through a training split and a held-out error calculation.

steps.description: You seed the generator and create 200 two-feature observations. y combines the two columns with known weights and added noise.
A shuffled index array separates 160 training rows from the remaining test rows. You append a constant bias column and fit least squares using only train indices.

steps.question: Which rows produce pred for the error calculation?
steps.answer: Only the test rows, selected by Xb[test], produce these predictions.

steps.description: You see learned weights [3.02, 19.86, 0.07]. The held-out root mean squared error, the square root of the mean squared prediction error, prints 4.02.
